title: Refactor Error Handling
problem_statement: The codebase lacks comprehensive error handling, relying on 'On Error Resume Next'.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for unhandled exceptions leading to application crashes.
suggested_approach: Introduce try-catch blocks in all modules and forms.
success_criteria: All modules and forms have appropriate error handling mechanisms.

title: Update ActiveX Dependencies
problem_statement: The application uses outdated ActiveX components.
risk_if_unaddressed: Incompatibility with modern operating systems and environments.
suggested_approach: Identify modern equivalents or refactor to remove dependency on ActiveX components.
success_criteria: All ActiveX dependencies are replaced or removed.
